name: Shiyounin to no Koi
source:
I will soon lose my noble status.  
The protagonist (enter name) is the only daughter of the regional noble Riche family. Since losing her mother a few years ago, her father, the head of the Riche family, has been unable to focus on work, and the Riche family has continued on a path of ruin. The protagonist spends uneasy days together with Alan, a servant who has been close to her since childhood.  

However, the downfall does not stop. With her fiancé Owen, the servant Alan, and in order to survive, what path will the protagonist choose?
[Translated from Freem page synopsis]
